narrative.overview:
Light, airy, and translucent: everything feels like clear aqua water with white tiles resting just under the surface. The page is a single seafoam-to-mist gradient; the header, the category tabs, the converter card and the result card sit on it as soft, rounded, gently lifted pieces. One teal accent family carries every interactive element, so the page never asks the visitor to decode more than "this is a button, this is where I type, this is the answer."

The system is small because the product is small. A quick lookup needs a calm, friendly surface that stays out of the way of the value and the result. Density is low, the layout is a single centered column, and personality comes from the water-toned color and the soft corners rather than from ornament.
keyCharacteristics: One accent family (Seafoam Mist to Lagoon, with Deep Teal for text) used for every action.
White cards on a tinted gradient; depth is a faint shadow, never a border.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (loaded from Google Fonts) is the only typeface, including on buttons and form controls.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every accent is Seafoam Mist or Lagoon. No second hue is introduced for status, category or decoration.

rules.name: The Gradient Direction Rule
rules.body: Surfaces fade from Seafoam Mist toward Mist Paper (page, 135deg) or toward Lagoon (header, 90deg; buttons, 45deg). Hover reverses a button's gradient rather than changing hue.

rules.name: The Deep Teal Text Rule
rules.body: Text on Seafoam Mist or Lagoon is Deep Teal, never white (white is 1.4-2:1 there). Lagoon is a fill, never a text or indicator color on white.

rules.name: The Plain Sans Rule
rules.body: One family, no italics, no uppercase, no letter-spacing tricks. Emphasis is weight 600/700 only.

rules.name: The Faint Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are ambient and nearly invisible. Interactivity is signalled by a 2px upward translate on hover, not by a heavier shadow.

rules.name: The Number Leads Rule
rules.body: The converted value is set at Display size, 700, Deep Teal, tabular figures, on its own line; the sentence that introduces it is Body in Ink Soft. Form inputs and selects use tabular figures and Ink, not the browser default black.

dos: Do keep every interactive element in the Seafoam Mist to Lagoon gradient with Deep Teal text and reverse the gradient on hover.
Do use the single 8px radius on every surface and control.
Do keep depth to Card rest and Header lift; place white cards on the tinted gradient.
Do keep layout a single centered column, 700px for content and 800px for the header.
Do keep the existing logo as the brand mark in the header.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue for status, category or decoration.
Don't use borders or heavy shadows to separate cards; tone and a faint shadow do that.
Don't set white text on Seafoam Mist or Lagoon, or use Lagoon as text or an indicator on white; use Deep Teal.
Don't remove a focus indicator without replacing it with an equally visible Deep Teal one.
Don't use pill shapes, uppercase labels, or decorative type; the system is one plain sans at a few sizes.
